# Hydro dMRV

> Digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV) for run-of-river hydropower on Hedera. A deterministic
> 5-layer engine verifies metered telemetry. The raw readings and the verdict are published on the Hedera Consensus
> Service (HCS), so any agent can reproduce a decision from public data. The HydroREC contract mints Hedera Token
> Service RECs (1 token = 1 MWh, 1 base unit = 1 kWh), sells them at USD prices settled in HBAR through Chainlink
> HBAR/USD cross-checked against a Supra fallback, and on retirement burns them and mints an HTS NFT certificate.

Everything below is relative to this site's origin. Read-only access needs no credentials. The server never holds a
buyer's key: purchases are returned as unsigned transactions.

## MCP (recommended for agents)

- Endpoint: `/api/mcp` (streamable HTTP, stateless; MCP 2025-06-18 and 2026-07-28)
- Verify: `list_scenarios`, `generate_sample_telemetry`, `verify_telemetry`
- Registry: `get_registry_overview` (totals, plants, tokens, both oracle sources), `list_attestations`
- Evidence: `audit_attestation` (report vs chain), `reproduce_attestation` (re-run the engine on the readings
  published to HCS and compare every figure)
- Market: `list_open_listings`, `prepare_purchase` (unsigned buy / buyAndRetire for your own wallet),
  `get_retirement_certificate`
- Write tool `submit_attestation` is listed only when the request carries `Authorization: Bearer <MRV_API_KEY>`
- Resource: `hydro-dmrv://methodology` (verification rules in Markdown)

Buying as an agent: `list_open_listings` → `prepare_purchase { listingId, amountKwh, beneficiary }` → sign and send
`{ to, data, value }` with your wallet on `chainId` → `get_retirement_certificate`.

## REST

- `GET  /api/mrv/scenarios` — sample scenarios and the demo plant profile
- `GET  /api/mrv/scenarios/{healthy|inflated|replay|spikes|polluted}?hours=24` — deterministic readings
- `POST /api/mrv/verify` — body `{ "readings": Reading[], "plant"?: PlantProfile }` → report, HCS report message,
  reportHash, dataHash, dataChunks
- `GET  /api/registry` — on-chain totals, plants, REC token, oracle status (price, active source, both providers)
- `GET  /api/registry/attestations?start=0&count=20` — attestations with HCS anchors
- `GET  /api/registry/attestations/{id}/audit` — report vs on-chain record
- `GET  /api/registry/attestations/{id}/reproduce` — full reproduction from HCS data
- `GET  /api/registry/listings` — open listings with HBAR quotes (tinybar)
- `POST /api/market/prepare-purchase` — body `{ listingId, amountKwh, retire?: true, beneficiary?: "" }`
- `GET  /api/registry/retirements/{id}` — retirement and NFT certificate
- `POST /api/mrv/attest` — verify → HCS (readings, report) → mint; requires `Authorization: Bearer <MRV_API_KEY>`

## Data shapes

- Reading: `{ timestamp (ISO 8601, end of interval), intervalMinutes, flowRateM3s, headM, energyKwh,
  efficiency?, ph?, turbidityNtu?, temperatureC? }`
- Decision: APPROVED (trust ≥ 0.90 and no failed interval), FLAGGED (trust ≥ 0.50), else REJECTED.
  Replayed timestamps, energy above nameplate capacity or >20% of intervals failing physics are always REJECTED.
- HCS: `hydro-dmrv/readings@1` (readings + plant profile, up to 20 chunks) then `hydro-dmrv/report@2`
  (verdict with `data: { hash, sequence }`). The contract stores sha256(report) and the report's sequence number.
- Prices: listings in US cents per MWh; quotes in the EVM's native unit (tinybar on Hedera); `prepare_purchase`
  returns `value` already scaled to 18-decimal weibar with a 1% buffer that the contract refunds.

## Source

- Contracts: `packages/hardhat/contracts/HydroREC.sol`, `ResilientHbarUsdFeed.sol`
- Engine: `packages/nextjs/services/mrv/engine.ts`; reproduction: `services/mrv/audit.ts`
- Agent briefing for coding agents: `AGENTS.md`
